SELECT ?bom (COUNT(?part) AS ?partCount) (SUM(?quantity) AS ?totalQuantity)

What share of each manager's overall team works in the same department as the manager?
query:
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?manager (COUNT(?sameDeptEmployee) AS ?sameDeptCount) (COUNT(?allDirectReports) AS ?totalReports) 
       ((COUNT(?sameDeptEmployee) / COUNT(?allDirectReports)) AS ?share)
WHERE {
  ?manager a pv:Manager ;
             pv:hasDirectReport ?allDirectReports .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?allDirectReports pv:memberOf ?dept .
    ?manager pv:memberOf ?dept .
    FILTER(?allDirectReports != ?manager)
    BIND(?allDirectReports AS ?sameDeptEmployee)
  }
}
GROUP BY ?manager

question: Bitte listen Sie alle Stücklisten auf, die mindestens ein Teil enthalten, das von einem polnischen Lieferanten bezogen wird.
query:
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?result WHERE {
  ?bom a pv:BillOfMaterial ;
       pv:hasBomPart ?bomPart .
  ?bomPart pv:hasPart ?product .
  ?product pv:hasSupplier ?supplier .
  ?supplier pv:country "Poland"^^xsd:string .
  BIND(?bom AS ?result)
}

question: How many suppliers can provide alternative compatible products for the K367 Strain Encoder?
Wie viele Lieferanten können alternative, kompatible Produkte für den K367-Dehnungsmesswandler anbieten?
query:
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?supplier) AS ?result) WHERE {
  prodi:hw-K367-Dehnungsmesswandler pv:compatibleProduct ?compatibleProduct .
  ?compatibleProduct pv:hasSupplier ?supplier .
}
